response.text: Your goal is to pull the previous day's orders from your Shopify store through the API and add them to a Google Sheet daily using a Python script, skipping duplicates and writing a log. I will write a Python script to authenticate with the Shopify API and fetch the previous day's orders including order number, date, customer email, items, total, and fulfillment status. Then I will integrate the Google Sheets API to append the fetched orders into the specified Google Sheet while checking existing rows to skip orders that are already recorded. Next I will implement rate limit handling for the Shopify API and add an execution logging mechanism. Finally I will configure the daily schedule for the Python script execution. I did nearly this: Shopify to PostgreSQL inventory sync. Stock synced every 15 minutes, with no oversold orders in the first month. Where would you prefer the script to be hosted and executed daily?
